description.value:
The hype thrall has no independent turns, actions, reactions, Strikes, or spells. Command Flash Mob grants support only, not the usual two minion actions. The thrall is stationary unless another ability moves it.

Attacks automatically hit the thrall, and it automatically fails all saving throws. It has 1 HP, is destroyed at 0 HP, and does not use dying rules. It can flank but cannot Strike.

Special The thrall grants no separate XP.

The thrall's space is difficult terrain, but other creatures can enter it as though it were unoccupied. A creature entering its space can automatically push the thrall into an adjacent space outside that creature's path.

Requirements Blaster uses Command Flash Mob while this living thrall is within 60 feet.

Effect The guard plants its hooves and raises a violet shield around its star. Its signature routine is @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-items.Item.BlasterAuraGrd01]{Guard Aura}: a 60-foot aura granting only its summoning Blaster a +1 status bonus to AC.

The benefit applies only while Blaster is within 60 feet.

The aura lasts until the start of Blaster's next turn, ending early if the thrall is destroyed or removed.

Blaster can instead choose either other Command Flash Mob benefit. This grants no extra action or free support.

speed.details: Stationary unless explicitly commanded; support commands grant no movement.

details.blurb: A smug stage bouncer who treats Blaster's ego as a VIP.
details.publicNotes:
A smug stage bouncer who treats Blaster's ego as a VIP. The guard plants its hooves and raises a violet shield around its star.

A 1-HP Flash Mob thrall with no independent turns or attacks. It lasts 1 minute and grants no separate XP.
details.privateNotes:
Derived from PF2e Summons Assistant's built-in Thrall. Preserve the thrall actor trait for the helper's self:trait:thrall predicate. Runtime adds summoner linkage, owner actor/token UUIDs, creation nonce, and the expiration marker without generating strikes. Do not add this token to initiative as an independent enemy.

Foundry Operating Notes

Support Shell

This is a disposable support minion, not a real bard or a separate level-18 enemy. Level 18 is a scaling shell for the summoning integration; AC and saving-throw values are placeholders. Retain the helper thrall's immunities and summoner linkage.

At 0 HP, remove its token; it no longer qualifies for support or the live cap. Automatic runtime cleanup occurs after 1 minute, not immediately at 0 HP. Command Flash Mob activates one aura on a living own thrall within 60 feet; only its summoning Blaster receives the benefit.

Yield the Stage

This forced displacement does not grant the thrall an independent move or a support command.

Command Flash Mob Auras

Select Blaster and use @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-macros.Macro.BlasterMobCmd001]{Command Thrall}. The command adds one native 60-foot aura emitter to the chosen living thrall. All three variants can Inspire, Guard, or Bolster; none has an active aura by default.

  • @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-items.Item.BlasterAuraIns01]{Inspire Aura} — green.
  • @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-items.Item.BlasterAuraGrd01]{Guard Aura} — violet.
  • @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-items.Item.BlasterAuraBol01]{Bolster Aura} — magenta.

For manual activation, pay the command action and drag one linked aura item onto a living thrall summoned through Flash Mob, within 60 feet of its Blaster. Manually placed, unlinked thralls cannot grant these benefits. Keep the Summons Assistant summoner signature and module owner linkage; the aura affects only that summoning Blaster, regardless of token disposition, never allies or the emitting thrall.

Runtime stamps the owner and activation timing on the emitter and benefits. Command support ends at the start of Blaster's next turn, even later in the same round after an off-turn command, or after 6 world-time seconds without combat. Ending, deleting, or expiring the aura, or destroying or deleting its thrall, ends every linked benefit.

Inspire and Guard apply only while Blaster is within 60 feet. Bolster grants temporary HP once per activation and retains its effect on exit, so re-entry never refills it. Only Bolster-granted temporary HP expire with the activation; higher temporary HP from another source keep their original duration. A new grant requires another command activation.
